name: Four Seasons Hotel Prague
insider_take: This baroque beauty sits on the banks of the Vltava River, where three historic buildings seamlessly blend 600 years of Prague architecture with Four Seasons luxury.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a remarkable trio of buildings dating from different centuries - a 14th-century baroque palace, an 18th-century neoclassical townhouse, and a contemporary structure that ties them together. Many rooms offer postcard-perfect views of Prague Castle, and the hotel's location in Lesser Town puts you steps from the iconic Charles Bridge.
pro_tip: Book a Castle View room on the upper floors - the sunrise views over Prague Castle and the red-tiled rooftops of Malá Strana are absolutely magical and worth the upgrade.
dont_miss: A morning walk across Charles Bridge (just 2 minutes away) before the crowds arrive, and dinner at CottoCrudo Restaurant for modern Italian cuisine with those stunning castle views. The hotel's spa treatments using local beer and hops are uniquely Czech experiences you won't find elsewhere.
pros: Prime location on the Vltava River with stunning views of Prague Castle
Elegant rooms combining historic Baroque architecture with modern luxury amenities
Exceptional Four Seasons service standards with personalized attention to detail
Historic building dating to 1776 offering authentic Prague cultural experience
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting Five-Star status
Historic building constraints may limit some modern facility expansions
